_doc: Per-ship atlases of the 1571, 1588 and 1805 ships: each kind takes its navy's atlas (atlasLayout.json) and swaps the cells named here for its own images, so no two kinds share hull paint, upper works or stern. Same cell layout, tiling and sizes as the navy's atlas. Written by scripts/ship-textures.mjs kinds; read by src/ships/build/atlas.ts (which kinds have one).

slots.hull_plank: Seamless tileable texture of the oak hull planking below the waterline wale of the English race-built galleon Ark Royal of 1588: long horizontal strakes about 30 cm wide, black pitch in the seams, tarred dark brown with grey salt bloom and green weed staining, iron nail heads, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.red_paint: Seamless tileable texture of the painted upper strakes of the English galleon Ark Royal of 1588: horizontal boards painted in the Tudor livery of horizontal stripes of Tudor green and off-white with a row of green-and-white painted lozenges, in faded flat paint (green and white only, no grey, no black), thin gilt fillets, paint flaking to dark oak, salt grime, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.black_paint: Seamless tileable texture of the waist and castle sides of the English galleon Ark Royal of 1588: horizontal oak boards with a faded red-ochre wash and narrow black-painted moulding battens every 50 cm, worn to bare wood at the edges, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.stern_panel: The flat transom of the English galleon Ark Royal of 1588 seen square-on from behind filling the whole square image edge to edge: two rows of small leaded casement windows with carved frames, the Tudor royal arms carved and painted in red, blue and gold in the centre, green and white painted panels with gilt carved borders, no text, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.

slots.hull_plank: Seamless tileable texture of the clinker-free carvel hull planking of a small English pinnace of 1588: narrow horizontal pine strakes about 20 cm wide, pitch-paid seams, light grey weathered wood with tar streaks and salt bloom, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.red_paint: Seamless tileable texture of the upper strakes of a small English pinnace of 1588: horizontal boards painted plain faded green with a single white stripe every 60 cm, scuffed and chipped to grey wood, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.black_paint: Seamless tileable texture of the low bulwark of an English pinnace of 1588: horizontal unpainted pine boards running left to right across the whole image (no vertical boards) silvered by sun and salt with black tarred battens, rope chafe marks, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.stern_panel: The small flat transom of an English pinnace of 1588 as a flat texture swatch: only the carved and painted face of the transom, which runs off all four edges of the image: plain planking painted faded green and white, a small carved Tudor rose in the centre, one small square window, rudder hinges of iron, no text, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.

slots.hull_plank: Seamless tileable texture of the hull of an old merchant ship turned into a fireship in 1588: horizontal oak strakes heavily charred and blistered, soot-black and scorched brown, cracked, tar running from the seams, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.red_paint: Seamless tileable texture of the upper strakes of an old merchant ship of 1588 prepared as a fireship: horizontal boards smeared with pitch and tar, old faded red paint showing through in patches, soot stains, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.black_paint: Seamless tileable texture of the bulwarks of a fireship of 1588: horizontal boards coated in glossy black pitch and tallow, drips and smears, scorch marks, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.stern_panel: The plain flat transom of an old Elizabethan merchant ship used as a fireship seen square-on from behind filling the whole square image edge to edge: tarred planks, two small shuttered windows, smeared pitch and soot, scorched edges, no text, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.

slots.hull_plank: Seamless tileable texture of the hull planking of the Spanish galleon San Martín of the 1588 Armada: long horizontal oak strakes about 30 cm wide, pitch-paid seams, dark tarred brown-black, white salt crust and weed near the bottom, iron spikes, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.red_paint: Seamless tileable texture of the painted upper strakes of the Spanish galleon San Martín of 1588: horizontal boards painted deep faded crimson red with a narrow gilt bead every 45 cm and small yellow painted castles and lions in a repeating frieze, paint chipped to dark wood, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.black_paint: Seamless tileable texture of the castle sides of the Spanish galleon San Martín of 1588: horizontal boards painted black with faded red and yellow painted strapwork panels, paint worn at the edges, salt grime, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.stern_panel: The high flat stern of the Spanish galleon San Martín, flagship of the 1588 Armada, seen square-on from behind filling the whole square image edge to edge: three tiers of carved galleries with balustrades and small glazed windows, the royal arms of Philip II carved, painted and gilded at the centre, red and black painted panels with gilt carved scrollwork and figures, no text, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.

slots.hull_plank: Seamless tileable texture of the hull planking of the Neapolitan galleass San Lorenzo of the 1588 Armada: long horizontal pine and oak strakes about 25 cm wide, black pitch seams, dark brown tarred wood with grey wear, salt and weed staining, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.red_paint: Seamless tileable texture of the painted upper strakes of a Neapolitan galleass of 1588: horizontal boards painted faded red with a band of yellow ochre and thin black lines along the seams, paint flaking to bare wood, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.black_paint: Seamless tileable texture of the oar-deck bulwark of a Neapolitan galleass of 1588: horizontal boards painted black with faded yellow painted oval cartouches spaced along it, scuffed, salt grime, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.stern_panel: The rounded carved stern of a Neapolitan galleass of 1588 seen square-on from behind filling the whole square image edge to edge: a gilt carved frame of scrolls and tritons around painted panels in red and yellow, a small carved Habsburg eagle at the top, two small windows, no text, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.

slots.hull_plank: Seamless tileable texture of the hull of a Baltic-built hulk (urca) supply ship of the 1588 Armada: broad horizontal oak strakes about 35 cm wide, tar-blackened, heavy wear and repairs with patched boards, salt bloom, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.red_paint: Seamless tileable texture of the upper strakes of a German hulk (urca) of 1588: horizontal boards with old faded blue-grey paint and a narrow red stripe, mostly worn to bare weathered wood, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.black_paint: Seamless tileable texture of the bulwarks of a merchant hulk of 1588: horizontal unpainted oak boards running left to right across the whole image, silvered grey, with a black tarred horizontal batten every 60 cm (nothing diagonal or vertical), rope chafe, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
slots.stern_panel: The plain round-tucked stern of a Hanseatic merchant hulk (urca) of 1588 as a flat texture swatch: only the carved and painted face of the transom, which runs off all four edges of the image: heavy tarred planking, a small cabin window pair with shutters, a simple carved and faded painted coat of arms of a Hanseatic town, no text, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.

slots.stern_panel: The richly carved and gilded stern of Don Juan of Austria's galley La Real of 1571 seen square-on from behind filling the whole square image edge to edge: gilt carved panels of mythological scenes and allegorical figures framed by gilt scrollwork on red and black, a carved crowned Habsburg coat of arms at the top, no text, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.

slots.stern_panel: The carved stern of a Venetian war galley of 1571 seen square-on from behind filling the whole square image edge to edge: a carved gilt lion of Saint Mark in a red painted panel framed by carved wooden scrolls, plain dark red planking around it, no text, weathered, aged, film-production prop, muted desaturated colours.
